decision: Reject string-built SQL in export-controller.ts:38; allowlist sortBy against the column enum and use placeholders.
rationale: SQL injection begins with one concatenated value; value provenance changes with every refactor.

decision: Require a reproducing test before the fix merges; the generated test must kill the injection mutant.
rationale: A fix without a reproducing test is a guess that compiled; coverage without mutation kill is hollow.

decision: Block implementation of the export feature until acceptance criteria define formats, authorized roles, and volume limits.
rationale: No implementation begins against undefined done; an agent given a one-line ticket manufactures the missing requirements.
